rationale: With only 3 minutes to close, any position opened now faces forced market liquidation, creating unacceptable slippage risk especially given REXR is trading at the absolute top of its daily range (100th percentile) with momentum stalling in the last few 1-minute candles. The stock has already gapped up ~2% and run to new highs; there is insufficient time to capture meaningful additional movement while managing downside risk, and the account is already down on the day with limited loss budget remaining.
